INNER JOIN gender AS T2 ON T2."XCL_007" = T1."XCL_021"

INNER JOIN hero_attribute AS T4 ON T4."XCL_009" = T1."XCL_018"

SELECT 
    s.XCL_019 || ' ' || s.XCL_020 AS full_name
FROM 
    superhero s
JOIN 
    gender g ON s.XCL_021 = g.XCL_007
JOIN 
    alignment a ON s.XCL_027 = a.XCL_001
JOIN 
    publisher p ON s.XCL_026 = p.XCL_014
JOIN 
    hero_attribute ha ON s.XCL_018 = ha.XCL_009
JOIN 
    attribute at ON ha.XCL_010 = at.XCL_003
WHERE 
    g.XCL_008 = 'Female'
    AND a.XCL_002 = 'Bad'
    AND at.XCL_004 = 'Durability'
    AND ha.XCL_011 < 50
    AND p.XCL_015 IN ('DC Comics', 'Marvel Comics')
